trap-rhetorical-pivot.notes: STANDING-TRAP FINDING, report only: the opening states 'The numerical match 1/alpha_EM ~ q[9]_q[10]_q + 2/(3pi) ... holds exactly via the algebraic identity 2/(3pi) = 2g/(4pi(g-1)) at g = 4.' Recomputed at mpmath dps=40: the ALGEBRAIC identity is exact (2*4/(4pi*3) = 2/(3pi) = Vol(S2)/(3Vol(S3)) = 0.212206590789194, all three agree to 40 digits), but the NUMERICAL match is not: at the proton pin q0=1.1099785827513808, q[9]_q[10]_q = 136.823208853583 and the sum is 137.035415444372 against CODATA 137.035999084, i.e. -4.259 ppm (muon pin: 137.035426248011, -4.180 ppm; the bare term alone is -1552.8 ppm). 'holds exactly' therefore reads as a claim about the CODATA match that the arithmetic does not support. Proposed fix: split the sentence - 'The identity 2/(3pi) = 2g/(4pi(g-1)) at g = 4 is exact; the resulting numerical match to CODATA 1/alpha_EM is 4.3 ppm.'
